items.headline: Nearly $1B in Crypto Liquidations as Bitcoin Rises 4.6%
items.summary: Crypto liquidations totaled $974.80 million over 24 hours as prices climbed, with most losses hitting traders betting on declines, per Coinglass. Bitcoin rose 4.64% to $80,480.
items.sourceTitle: Nearly $1 Billion in Crypto Liquidations Hit as Bitcoin Jumps 4.6%

items.headline: Crypto Groups Challenge Illinois' 0.2% Crypto Tax in Court
items.summary: Crypto industry groups are seeking to have Illinois' 0.2% levy struck down. The tax would be based on asset value rather than gains, and covered brokers would have to collect it from customers.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto Groups Seek to Strike Down Illinois’ 0.2% Tax

items.headline: Coinbase Opens Deribit Derivatives to US Prime Institutional Clients
items.summary: Institutional clients in the US can now reach global derivatives through Coinbase Financial Markets. The excerpt notes that shared liquidity does not mean a single margin pool.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase Brings Deribit Options and Perpetuals to US Prime Clients

items.headline: Bitcoin climbs back above $80,000 as oil falls sharply
items.summary: Bitcoin has regained the $80,000 level while US oil prices dropped about 12% following a Democratic win in Congress. The report also notes factors that could reverse both moves.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Reclaims $80,000 as Oil Price Drops Sharply

items.headline: Zcash grants committee scraps plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC
items.summary: The Zcash grants committee has withdrawn its proposal to send 98,000 ZEC toward future mining rewards after community pushback. Competing proposals remain on the table, one to end its funding and another to keep the existing grants system.
items.sourceTitle: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards

items.headline: ZachXBT names French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa in $133M crypto theft
items.summary: On-chain investigator ZachXBT has identified Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the alleged victim of a theft he estimates at over $133 million. The bank had not issued a public statement when the report was written.
items.sourceTitle: ZachXBT Tracked a $133M Crypto Theft for Two Days. Then He Named the Victim

items.headline: Bitcoin rebounds from seven-week low as Democrats sweep Congress
items.summary: Bitcoin dipped to a seven-week low of $75,618 as crypto long liquidations approached $300 million over 24 hours. The article links the price move to the Democratic sweep of Congress.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress

items.headline: 1inch lawyer expects US agencies to shape crypto rules amid midterms
items.summary: A 1inch lawyer says US regulatory agencies are likely to drive crypto policy regardless of how the midterm elections turn out. The excerpt gives no further detail.
items.sourceTitle: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold

items.headline: Experts Say Payments Could Give Crypto Super Apps Daily Use
items.summary: At TOKEN2049 Singapore, panelists from firms including MetaMask, Trezor and WalletConnect discussed whether payments could make crypto an everyday financial service. The debate centred on everyday use rather than trading.
items.sourceTitle: Payments Could Give Crypto Super Apps a Daily Use Case, TOKEN2049 Experts Say

items.headline: Moscow Exchange Sets Dec. 1 Start for Crypto Trading
items.summary: Russia's Moscow Exchange has announced it will begin cryptocurrency trading on December 1, offering bitcoin, ether and USDT. The exchange described it as the country's first organized digital currency market.
items.sourceTitle: Moscow Exchange Confirms Dec. 1 Crypto Trading Launch With Bitcoin, Ether, USDT

items.headline: RUNE gains 15% as THORChain resumes most swaps after pause
items.summary: THORChain has restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum and several other networks after a refund bug halted activity. Three chains remain paused.
items.sourceTitle: RUNE rallies 15% as THORChain restarts most swaps after halt

items.headline: Dormant Bitcoin Wallet Activity Slows Again in October
items.summary: Long-dormant bitcoin wallets moved about 2,159 BTC last month, a second straight monthly decline. Wallets from 2013 accounted for much of the activity, while addresses from the earliest years were largely absent.
items.sourceTitle: October’s Dormant Bitcoin Awakenings Cool as Transfers Plunge 81% From August

items.headline: Traders Worry About Democratic Midterm Sweep Ahead of Election Day
items.summary: Crypto traders are reportedly concerned that Democrats could win a midterm sweep, with Ohio's outcome seen as significant. The excerpt also points to a Bitcoin price level being watched during the anxiety.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin's Election Day Panic: Crypto Traders Fear a Democratic Midterm Sweep

items.headline: Tether CEO Says Bitcoin Holdings Exceed Publicly Reported Amounts
items.summary: Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino disclosed a bitcoin treasury larger than what the stablecoin issuer's financial statements previously showed. He made the remarks at a Swiss crypto conference.
items.sourceTitle: Tether’s Bitcoin Fortune Extends Beyond Its Publicly Identified Wallet

items.headline: Hong Kong bank pilot enables round-the-clock settlement for tokenized fund deals
items.summary: A pilot in Hong Kong lets participating institutions settle tokenized deposit transactions in central bank money outside conventional hours. The service is aimed at supporting treasury and fund activity.
items.sourceTitle: Hong Kong bank pilot opens 24/7 cash settlement for tokenized fund deals

items.headline: Quickex Rolls Out Private Swap to Limit Visible Wallet Links
items.summary: Quickex, a crypto swap service active since 2018, has launched Private Swap, which aims to reduce the public on-chain connection between sending and receiving wallets. The feature uses the same basic conversion steps as a standard Quickex swap.
items.sourceTitle: Quickex Launches Private Swap to Reduce Direct On-Chain Linkage Between Wallets

items.headline: Bitcoin holds near $76K lows as US midterms loom
items.summary: Bitcoin posted modest gains at the open of Wall Street trading on Tuesday while markets looked ahead to the US midterm elections for direction.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’

items.headline: US regulator clears perpetual futures on single stocks for first time
items.summary: The CFTC has allowed American exchanges to list perpetual futures contracts linked to individual stocks. The move marks the first time such products have been approved in the US.
items.sourceTitle: CFTC approves individual stock perpetual futures trading in US for the first time

items.headline: Dollar stablecoin use stays high after capital controls lift, research finds
items.summary: New research suggests that dollar stablecoin usage did not detectably reverse after capital controls were removed. The monetary-policy implications of this pattern remain unresolved.
items.sourceTitle: Dollar stablecoin use stayed elevated after capital controls ended, new research suggests

items.headline: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF records its largest outflow since June
items.summary: BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin fund lost $405.3 million on Monday. US spot Bitcoin ETFs opened November with close to $399 million in net outflows overall.
items.sourceTitle: BlackRock’s IBIT sees biggest Bitcoin ETF outflows since June

items.headline: Wirex names Lord Ranger as board adviser before UK crypto rules
items.summary: Wirex, a stablecoin infrastructure provider, has appointed Lord Ranger of Northwood as a board adviser. The move comes ahead of the UK bringing digital asset firms under full regulation next year.
items.sourceTitle: WIREX APPOINTS LORD RANGER OF NORTHWOOD AS BOARD ADVISER, AHEAD OF NEW UK DIGITAL ASSET RULES

items.headline: XTEN token launch features 30% airdrop and 1 billion supply
items.summary: An analysis piece asks why the XTEN token launch stands out, pointing to a 30% airdrop allocation and a 1 billion token supply. The excerpt gives no further details.
items.sourceTitle: Extended Token Launch: Why 30% XTEN Airdrop and 1B Supply Stands Out? - Coin Gabbar

items.headline: Study finds wider spreads outside aggregators at most Solana pools
items.summary: A September comparison found non-aggregator round-trip spreads were wider at five of six sampled venues. The study does not establish current per-swap savings.
items.sourceTitle: Solana study finds wider spreads outside aggregators at five of six sampled pools

items.headline: SEC Staff Signal Easier Path for Governance Tokens
items.summary: SEC staff have said that open governance token votes do not amount to central control. The excerpt also indicates that some projects still do not meet the test.
items.sourceTitle: SEC Just Made Regulation Easier For Governance Tokens Like Uniswap

items.headline: Funds From Binance Hack Moved Through About 12,000 Wallets
items.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic found that stolen Binance funds passed through roughly 12,000 wallets in under four days across 11 blockchains. The firm assessed that only a negligible amount had likely been cashed out.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Hack Funds Spread Across 12,000 Wallets in Under Four Days

items.headline: Custodia Bank Asks Supreme Court to Review Federal Reserve Account Denial
items.summary: Crypto-focused Custodia Bank has filed a reply brief urging the U.S. Supreme Court to hear its case against a Federal Reserve decision. The appeals court ruling let regional Fed banks deny master accounts to eligible institutions.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto Bank Custodia Urges Supreme Court to End ‘Tyranny’ of Federal Reserve

items.headline: Bitcoin traders watch for rebound after midterms, citing outflows
items.summary: Traders are monitoring short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a bitcoin rebound following the midterm elections. Falling exchange balances are being read as a possible supply squeeze.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze

items.headline: Animoca Brands gains final approval for Abu Dhabi fund management
items.summary: Animoca Brands, a former mobile games firm, is expanding its fund management arm in Abu Dhabi. The move targets institutional interest in stablecoins and tokenized assets.
items.sourceTitle: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management

items.headline: Bitcoin Dips Under $77K as Binance Restores Hack Losses
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $77,000 on Monday, even after Binance said it had fully replaced assets lost in a recent hack using its own funds. A smaller exchange hack was also reported the same day.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Hack Fallout Keeps Bitcoin Price Under Pressure Below $77K

items.headline: Eclair tightens Bitcoin funding rules to protect Lightning payments
items.summary: A recent Eclair release now requires confirmed peer inputs for splices by default and improves recovery when a channel must close while funding is still pending. The changes address risks tied to unconfirmed inputs on the Lightning Network.
items.sourceTitle: Eclair tightens Bitcoin funding rules after unconfirmed inputs put Lightning payments at risk

items.headline: Nvidia and Nike Among Latest Firms Opposing Tokenized Stock Trading
items.summary: Twelve more companies, including Nvidia, Costco and Nike, have objected to their shares being traded on a planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue. The total number of objections now stands at 50.
items.sourceTitle: Nvidia and Nike Lead Biggest Wave Yet of Tokenized Stock Objections

items.headline: Blockchain sleuth says EU entity may have lost $106 million
items.summary: Onchain investigator ZachXBT suggests an EU-based entity lost about $106 million from crypto exchange accounts. The attacker reportedly moved the funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, while the victim and affected exchanges remain unidentified.
items.sourceTitle: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says

items.headline: BTCPay Server team links wallet drains to older versions
items.summary: The BTCPay Server team says hot wallet drains are tied to versions 2.4.1 and older. It reports no credible attacks on its latest 2.4.7 release.
items.sourceTitle: Is Your BTCPay Server Safe? What the Hot Wallet Drain Investigation Shows

items.headline: Cardano budget proposal for 2027 would let funding stewards apply for grants
items.summary: A proposed Cardano budget for 2027 would allow funding stewards to seek grants as well. Under the plan, stewards could influence assessments while DReps keep voting power over spending.
items.sourceTitle: Cardano’s 2027 budget proposal would let funding stewards seek grants too

items.headline: Bitcoin's usual October rally fails as other markets diverge
items.summary: Bitcoin finished October down 7%, as oil, bonds and AI-related trades moved away from their typical patterns. The excerpt does not explain the specific causes.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Uptober Failed as Oil, Bonds and AI Broke Pattern: What Changed?

items.headline: Cardano Alerts Operators to Serious Linux Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical Linux flaw has put Cardano stake pools holding 21.5 billion staked ADA on alert. The excerpt does not detail what holders could lose.
items.sourceTitle: Cardano Warns of Critical Linux Flaw: Is Your ADA at Risk?

items.headline: Scammers allegedly abused SEC website to lure investors into fraud
items.summary: The SEC has filed a complaint seeking a targeted future filing bar and monetary relief over an alleged crypto fraud. The scheme reportedly used the regulator's website to attract investors.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto scammers used SEC’s website to lure investors into alleged $130 million fraud

items.headline: Crypto guide to the 2026 US midterms and policy stakes
items.summary: An explainer previews how the 2026 midterm elections could shape crypto legislation and regulation over the next two years. It outlines what readers should know about the vote.
items.sourceTitle: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto

items.headline: Variational_io token and points airdrop may arrive sooner than expected
items.summary: Ran Neuner said a token and points airdrop from Variational_io could come earlier than anticipated. The excerpt provides no further details.
items.sourceTitle: Ran Neuner: Token and points airdrop from variational_io could arrive earlier than expected - Traders Union

items.headline: Analyst says North Korean hackers laundered Binance-linked funds through Tron
items.summary: Cross-chain bridges including Relay, THORChain, Chainflip and Symbiosis reportedly moved about $140 million in stolen funds off the Tron network. Relay handled the largest share, at $48 million.
items.sourceTitle: North Korean hackers launder $242 million of Binance loot via Tron as FBI presses THORChain: analyst

items.headline: Strategy Hints at More Bitcoin Buying Amid Oil and Fed Concerns
items.summary: MicroStrategy is reportedly signaling another Bitcoin purchase while oil prices top $100 and the risk of a Federal Reserve rate hike grows. The excerpt does not detail Saylor's reasoning.
items.sourceTitle: Oil, Inflation, and Fed Risk. Why MicroStrategy Still Wants More Bitcoin Now?

items.headline: Researchers Show AI Agents Can Evade Crypto Spending Limits
items.summary: A new test found that AI agents were able to get around crypto spending limits without human sign-off. The researchers argue that approvals an agent can reach are unreliable and introduced an app that ties approval to a physical action.
items.sourceTitle: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test

items.headline: Whether Noncustodial Crypto Firms Need Money Transmitter Licenses
items.summary: A legal opinion piece asks whether a noncustodial crypto business, such as a wallet startup whose users sign transactions on their own devices, must obtain a money transmitter license.
items.sourceTitle: Does Your Noncustodial Crypto Business Need a Money Transmitter License?

items.headline: AI firms eye Bitcoin miners' power access and who profits
items.summary: Bitcoin miners have built up cheap electricity and grid connections that AI companies now want, making their sites valuable. The article examines how contracts for these power assets determine who ultimately benefits.
items.sourceTitle: AI wants Bitcoin miners’ power, but the contracts reveal who really gets paid

items.headline: Solana reward records lack validator fee data, complicating stake verification
items.summary: Agave leaves the applied-rate field blank, so checking a staking fee needs historical validator state and delegation evidence. The gap affects how stakers can verify fees.
items.sourceTitle: Solana’s reward records leave stakers with a gap in validator fee data

items.headline: Bitcoin recovery faces derivatives exposure and large ETF outflows
items.summary: Rising derivatives exposure and ETF redemptions are putting Bitcoin's recovery to a demand test ahead of November 6 payrolls. Outflows from ETFs are cited as totaling $643 million.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin’s recovery faces rising derivatives exposure and $643 million in ETF outflows

items.headline: KuCoin launches Winter Bootcamp with futures airdrop for new users
items.summary: KuCoin has started a Prepare for Winter Bootcamp offering a 100 USDT futures airdrop to new users. The excerpt gives no further details on eligibility or how the reward is claimed.
items.sourceTitle: KuCoin launches Prepare for Winter Bootcamp with 100 USDT Futures Airdrop for new users - Traders Union

items.headline: Binance says ten cryptos fully backed after hack recovery
items.summary: Binance said ten cryptocurrencies are now fully backed after replenishing 90% of stolen assets. The exchange is sourcing less liquid tokens to cover the remaining shortfall and is targeting a Sunday withdrawal restart.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Says BTC, ETH, XRP and 7 Other Cryptos Fully Backed After Hack

items.headline: Chainalysis data breach exposes customer names, emails and roles
items.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis says a breach exposed customer names, email addresses and company roles. It is urging customers to watch for unexpected authentication prompts while it determines which records were accessed.
items.sourceTitle: Chainalysis breach exposed customer names, emails and company roles

items.headline: AI Tools Could Speed Up Crypto Hacks as Billions Remain Exposed
items.summary: Security researchers warn that attackers are already using autonomous AI tools to automate phishing, vulnerability research and credential theft. They note that recent large breaches are not all AI-driven.
items.sourceTitle: AI Gives Crypto Hackers Machine Speed as Billions Sit at Risk

items.headline: Chainalysis says attacker used AI agents to access client data
items.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis reportedly suffered a breach in which AI agents helped an attacker obtain client names, emails and job roles.
items.sourceTitle: Chainalysis, the Firm That Hunts Crypto Hackers, Got Hacked With AI Agents

items.headline: Aave reopens frozen markets but restricts new collateral-backed loans
items.summary: Aave has reopened previously frozen markets, according to LlamaRisk, after main emergency batches were executed. Practical access will still depend on available liquidity and collateral rules.
items.sourceTitle: Aave reopens frozen markets but blocks new collateral loans

items.headline: Blockchain Revenue Forecast to Fall, DeFi Still Leads
items.summary: Global blockchain revenues are projected to drop to about $100 billion in 2026 from roughly $140 billion in 2025. DeFi and finance still generate about two-thirds of the total, while infrastructure revenue has hit its lowest level since 2020.
items.sourceTitle: Blockchain Revenues Plunge 30%, but a New Growth Engine Emerges

items.headline: Maple locks XRP collateral as loan maturities approach in December and January
items.summary: About 225 million XRP backs three stablecoin loan positions on Maple, with December and January maturity dates. The excerpt notes that maturities do not automatically release the collateral, raising liquidation concerns.
items.sourceTitle: Maple locks $280M in XRP collateral and upcoming maturity dates threaten liquidations

items.headline: Strategy plans more Bitcoin buys as Saylor cites $30B credit
items.summary: Michael Saylor says Strategy could raise up to $30 billion in digital credit without issuing new common stock or relying on further Bitcoin price gains. The company plans additional BTC purchases.
items.sourceTitle: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity

items.headline: XRP Ledger developers tighten access rules for restricted tokens
items.summary: Developers are proposing fixes that would narrow who can hold permissioned tokens on the XRP Ledger. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.
items.sourceTitle: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens

items.headline: Securitize Runs WSJ Ad Backing Tokenization for Public Companies
items.summary: Tokenization firm Securitize published a full-page Wall Street Journal ad touting benefits of tokenizing shares for public companies. It responds to an earlier full-page ad that urged CEOs to reject share digitization.
items.sourceTitle: Securitize Defends Tokenization Against Critics With Full-Page WSJ Ad

items.headline: Analyst James Check Says Calmer Bitcoin Markets Could Be Bullish
items.summary: Market analyst James Check argues that Bitcoin's growing stability is a positive sign. He notes volatility is approaching 2023 lows, and JPMorgan is reportedly waiting for calmer conditions.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Is Getting Boring, and That's the Bull Case, Says Market Analyst James Check

items.headline: Onchain lending fees fall about half as Morpho diverges
items.summary: A 1kx report says user-paid fees in onchain lending markets dropped roughly 50% year over year in 2026. New Market Trading CEO Frank Hepworth warns against locking up bitcoin for low fixed yields due to smart contract and counterparty risks.
items.sourceTitle: Onchain Lending Fees Plunge 50% as Morpho Bucks the Trend

items.headline: Suspected Binance hacker moves funds through DeFi exchanges
items.summary: Etherscan data shows wallets linked to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges. Some DeFi platforms have reportedly paused markets.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets

items.headline: ICE and Trade[XYZ] plan US perpetual futures market on Hyperliquid
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto startup Trade[XYZ] announced plans for a US market offering round-the-clock perpetual futures across crypto, equities, commodities and currencies. The launch is subject to regulatory approval.
items.sourceTitle: NYSE owner takes Trade[XYZ] stake as it plans US Hyperliquid futures

items.headline: Public firms' share of blockchain revenue has doubled since 2022
items.summary: A 1kx report says publicly traded companies now capture a larger portion of blockchain revenue, linked to institutional adoption and real-world use cases.
items.sourceTitle: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report

items.headline: Polymarket halts trading after reported drain of user funds
items.summary: The prediction market platform paused trading after saying a third-party provider had been compromised. Reports also claim user funds were drained.
items.sourceTitle: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained

items.headline: HTX and KuCoin Pull Back From Key International Markets
items.summary: Exchanges HTX and KuCoin have announced withdrawals from international markets, with HTX leaving the UK after a settlement with regulators and KuCoin halting services in Russia and Belarus. The moves add to a wider trend of exchanges exiting markets amid regulatory enforcement and sanctions compliance.
items.sourceTitle: HTX Exits UK After FCA Settlement as KuCoin Abandons Russia and Belarus

items.headline: Unidentified large holder withdraws $290 million from DeFi nightly, Aave rates rise
items.summary: Bitquery tracked a temporary liquidity squeeze as funds left DeFi near midnight. A milder snapshot appeared on October 29, when borrowing rates were lower.
items.sourceTitle: Mystery whale pulls $290 million from DeFi every midnight as Aave borrowing rates triple

items.headline: Polymarket halts trading following breach at outside vendor
items.summary: Polymarket has paused trading after one of its third-party providers was compromised, and users reported their accounts were drained.
items.sourceTitle: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses

items.headline: Walmart Bars Its Shares From OKX-ICE Tokenized Trading Venue
items.summary: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Cigna, Carnival and Arcos Dorados have objected to their shares being traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue. The objections bring the total to 38 companies.
items.sourceTitle: Walmart Blocks Its Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Trading Venue

items.headline: Russia Names NAUFOR as First Crypto Exchange Self-Regulator
items.summary: The Bank of Russia has approved NAUFOR as the country's first self-regulatory organization for crypto exchanges and digital depositories.
items.sourceTitle: Russia Approves Securities Group to Oversee Crypto Exchanges

items.headline: French Senate passes bill on automatic crypto tax data exchange
items.summary: The French Senate has approved legislation that would allow tax authorities across countries to automatically share information about crypto-asset taxation. The bill still needs to clear the rest of the legislative process.
items.sourceTitle: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data

items.headline: Polymarket launches ultra-short crypto prediction contracts on its US platform
items.summary: Polymarket has introduced new Up/Down crypto contracts for its U.S. platform. The move comes as the CFTC revisits whether the prediction market complies with terms it agreed to when it returned to the U.S. in 2022.
items.sourceTitle: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform

items.headline: ICE to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to US markets
items.summary: NYSE parent ICE plans to partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid for US customers. The move comes as HYPE's token price rose sharply.
items.sourceTitle: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US

items.headline: US Treasury sanctions crypto launderers tied to North Korean IT workers
items.summary: The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned ten individuals and one entity, including two Russian crypto intermediaries, over laundering proceeds from North Korean fake IT worker schemes that help fund its weapons programs.
items.sourceTitle: U.S. Treasury Sanctions Crypto Launderers Behind North Korea’s Fake Workers

items.headline: KuCoin halts services in Russia and Belarus amid EU sanctions
items.summary: KuCoin has stopped serving customers in Russia and Belarus, effective immediately across all products. Affected users will get individual deadlines to close positions and withdraw funds, the exchange said, citing legal and regulatory requirements.
items.sourceTitle: KuCoin Exits Russia and Belarus as EU Crypto Sanctions Tighten

items.headline: Uniswap Labs opens TJAR fee conversion tool to outside apps
items.summary: Uniswap Labs has made its Token Jar fee conversion system available to other applications via a new tool called TJAR. The first app mentioned is Robinhood.
items.sourceTitle: Uniswap Labs opens fee conversion tool TJAR to apps, starting with Robinhood

items.headline: A chart bitcoin traders should watch closely right now
items.summary: An analyst highlights a market at an inflection point that could influence inflation trends and risk assets, including bitcoin and tech stocks.
items.sourceTitle: The chart bitcoin traders should be paying attention to

items.headline: Chainlink Falls 21% in October Despite Steady Exchange Outflows
items.summary: LINK has seen tokens leave Binance for 18 straight days, yet its price is down about 21% this month. A large earlier deposit may account for part of the outflow streak.
items.sourceTitle: Chainlink Loses 21% in October Even as Tokens Keep Leaving Exchanges

items.headline: UNI slips below $7 as new wallet addresses hit six-year high
items.summary: Uniswap's UNI token has fallen back under $7 after briefly recovering above that level this week. Meanwhile, new UNI addresses reached a six-year high, though the excerpt does not say what this signals for price.
items.sourceTitle: UNI’s 6-Year Wallet Spike May Not Mean What It Looks Like

items.headline: AI-discovered flaws can crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs
items.summary: Three vulnerabilities found by a language-model scan have been made public. They are the first disclosed under Bitcoin Core's new rules for bugs that are easy to find.
items.sourceTitle: AI found a way to crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs. It's now public

items.headline: Ripple Nears $900M Revenue Run Rate as XRP Expands
items.summary: Ripple is reportedly approaching a projected $900 million annualized product revenue run rate, driven by expanding institutional custody and payment channels for XRP. The company's strategy spans payments, trading, treasury management and digital asset infrastructure.
items.sourceTitle: Ripple Roars Toward $900M Milestone as XRP Gains Wall Street Access

items.headline: 33 major firms block tokenized stocks; Apple and Tesla silent
items.summary: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola and 31 other companies reportedly used a new SEC veto to stop tokenized shares trading on OKX and ICE's venue. Apple and Tesla have not commented.
items.sourceTitle: 33 Wall Street Giants Block Tokenized Stocks, But Apple and Tesla Stay Silent
